description: Traffic for one app: visitors, pages, sources, countries, devices, goals, revenue by source. range adds the previous period, funnels, live visitors, bots, crawlers, AI assistants, buyers, cohorts, speed, 404s and paths. breakdown + rank: top lists. filter narrows the visits.

app.description: The app: its slug, name, domain (shop.app), URL or id. list_apps shows them all.

compare.description: Also the previous period, for trends

days.description: The last N days, only when range isn't passed. With breakdown, compare or filter it rounds up to 24h, 7d, 30d or 90d

filter.description: Only visits matching all of these, with values as a breakdown shows them: { source: "Google", country: "DE", page: "/pricing", device: "mobile" }. Several values of one kind, separated by |, mean any of them: { country: "DE|FR" }; for pages, start with all: to need every page: { page: "all:/pricing|/docs" }. Narrows every visit number in the answer; detail.notFiltered lists the blocks that stay whole-app.

range.description: Replaces days for every number in the answer. Longer than 90 days: totals come from daily history; breakdowns, funnels and paths cover the last 90 days

name: get_analytics
title: Traffic
